duplicateStudioRenders.reason: A file inside public/jobs/render-* is disposable only when its SHA-256 matches a file that already lives on a protected path. Unique renders stay.

temporaryFiles.reason: Install log. The vendored library and package manifest remain.
Typecheck log. Re-run tsc to regenerate.

aggressive.regenerate: The next Remotion bundle() or webpack build rebuilds this directory. Stop any in-progress render first. No package reinstall is required for this folder alone.
Remotion downloads Chrome headless shell again on the next render. That requires network access. Do not remove it during an active render.
The next Vite dev or build prebundles dependencies again. No package reinstall is required for this folder alone.
Reinstall with: node scripts/npm.mjs ci   This also removes the webpack cache, the Remotion browser, and the Vite cache. Do not run it while another agent is installing, typechecking, or rendering.
